summary: Frontend-only regression + new Leadership Lab feature testing. /leadership-lab hub renders 3 cards (assessment, library, games). /library shows 9 book cards; Art of War page shows title, all 4 tabs (overview/read/listen/watch), amazon link (amazon.com search), and credit. Read tab loads real Gutenberg prose (~320k chars). Listen tab renders Archive.org iframe with src https://archive.org/embed/artofwar_1402_librivox. Watch tab renders book-videos. Copyrighted /library/extreme-ownership correctly shows only Overview + Watch tabs, no Read/Listen, with Amazon button + credit + key lessons. /assessment: 20 Mini-IPIP questions render, all 5 options per question, submit enables after answering all 20, result renders in ~10-15s with quadrant-name ('Visionary Commander'), quadrant-dot, and narrative sections including Strengths, Blind spots, Roadmap, and 'SK's read'. Regression: home, /explore, /sectors/renewable-energy, /learning all load with correct titles and no console errors (except unrelated 401s from a background resource and expected archive.org custom-element warnings).

issues: Consent banner (fixed bottom) can intercept clicks on the submit button/last question options if not dismissed. Not a blocker for real users but noted.

critical_code_review_comments: Console shows repeated 401 errors on every page load — a background auth/session fetch is failing silently. Not blocking UX but should be investigated (likely /api/auth/me before login).
Consent banner z-index (z-[70]) sits above interactive quiz options and can intercept clicks; consider auto-dismissing on route change or lowering blocking area.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Leadership Lab feature is fully working end-to-end. When automating the assessment quiz, dismiss the consent banner first (button 'Essential only' or 'Accept all') otherwise it intercepts pointer events on the bottom-most questions/submit. Claude blueprint generation took ~10-15s in this run.
